IS: 8869 -1978 




( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 



Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
WASHERS FOR CORRUGATED SHEET ROOFING 



1. Scope — Covers the requirements for washers for corrugated sheet roofing. 

2. Types — The following types of washers are covered: 

a) Bituminous felt washers, 

b) Steel washers, and 

c) Lead washers. 

3. Dimensions — Dimensions of washers for corrugated sheet roofing shall be as given in 
Tables 1, 2 and 3. 





TABLE 1 DIMENSIONS FOR BITUMINOUS FELT WASHERS

4. Grade — Washers shall conform to ordinary grade as specified in IS : 5369-19/5 'General 
requirements for plain washers and lock washers ( first revision ) \ 

5. Material 

5.1 Steel washers shall be made from any suitable low carbon steel. 

5.2 Lead washers shaii be made from lead sheets as specified in IS : 405-1961 ! Specification for 
lead sheet (revised) ' . 

6. Designation — Designation of washers shall be as given in Table 4. 

7. Sampling — The method of sampling and acceptance criteria shall be in accordance with 
IS : 6821-1973 ' Methods for sampling non-threaded fasteners '. 

8. General Requirements 

8.1 Steel washers for corrugated roofing shall be galvanized by hot dipping as specified in 
IS : 5358-1969 ' Specification for hot-dip galvanized coatings on fasteners \

8.2 Bituminous felt washers shall be suitably impregnated. These washers when heated and 
maintained at a temperature of 75 ± 1°C for 1 hour shall not get separated and flow out. 

9. ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Subsequent to the decision to revise IS : 730-1966 ' Specification for fasteners for corrugated 
sheet roofing ( revised) ' splitting into three standards, this standard has been prepared on washers. 
Requirements of hook bolts and mushroom head bolts are being covered in separate Indian 
Standards. 

In this standard washers suitable for bolt size M5 have not been covered. 

This standard has been brought in line with BS 1494: Part 1:1964 'Fixing accessories 
for building purposes ' issued by British Standards Institution. 



Printed at Neelkamal Printers, Delhi, India
